passages.sermon:
This is a song.
People sing this song as they go up to Jerusalem.
They call it a song of ascents.

passages.text: Those who trust in the LORD are like Mount Zion. It cannot be moved; it abides forever.
passages.sermon:
This is a song of ascents.
It speaks about people who trust in the LORD.
These people are like Mount Zion.
Mount Zion stands firm.
It cannot be moved.
It remains forever.
passages.original: שִׁ֗יר הַֽמַּ֫עֲל֥וֹת הַבֹּטְחִ֥ים בַּיהוָ֑ה כְּֽהַר־ צִיּ֥וֹן לֹא־ יִ֝מּ֗וֹט לְעוֹלָ֥ם יֵשֵֽׁב׃

passages.text: As the mountains surround Jerusalem, so the LORD surrounds His people, both now and forevermore.
passages.sermon:
Jerusalem is a city.
Mountains surround Jerusalem.
The LORD is God.
The LORD surrounds His people.
He surrounds them just as the mountains surround Jerusalem.
The LORD protects His people now.
The LORD will protect His people forever.
passages.original: יְֽרוּשָׁלִַ֗ם הָרִים֮ סָבִ֪יב לָ֥הּ וַ֭יהוָה סָבִ֣יב לְעַמּ֑וֹ מֵ֝עַתָּ֗ה וְעַד־ עוֹלָֽם׃

passages.text: For the scepter of the wicked will not rest upon the land allotted to the righteous, so that the righteous will not put forth their hands to injustice.
passages.sermon:
The scepter of the wicked will not remain over the land of the righteous.
God gives land to the righteous.
The wicked will not rule over this land.
God does this so the righteous will not do wrong.
The righteous will not use their hands for injustice.
God protects the righteous from evil rule.
God keeps the righteous from turning to wrongdoing.
passages.original: כִּ֤י לֹ֪א יָנ֡וּחַ שֵׁ֤בֶט הָרֶ֗שַׁע עַל֮ גּוֹרַ֪ל הַֽצַּדִּ֫יקִ֥ים לְמַ֡עַן לֹא־ יִשְׁלְח֖וּ הַצַּדִּיקִ֨ים בְּעַוְלָ֬תָה יְדֵיהֶֽם׃

passages.text: Do good, O LORD, to those who are good, and to the upright in heart.
passages.sermon:
The LORD is the God of Israel.
The LORD has power to do good.
Some people are good.
Some people are upright in heart.
LORD, do good to those who are good.
LORD, do good to those who are upright in heart.

passages.text: But those who turn to crooked ways the LORD will banish with the evildoers. Peace be upon Israel.
passages.sermon:
The LORD judges all people.
Some people turn away from what is right.
These people choose crooked ways.
The LORD will send these people away.
He will send them away with those who do evil.
The LORD gives peace to Israel.
passages.original: וְהַמַּטִּ֤ים עַֽקַלְקַלּוֹתָ֗ם יוֹלִיכֵ֣ם יְ֭הוָה אֶת־ פֹּעֲלֵ֣י הָאָ֑וֶן שָׁ֝ל֗וֹם עַל־ יִשְׂרָאֵֽל׃
